budget_items.topic: 41A property tax deferral income limits (Article II)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The current $20,000 income limit is proposed to rise to circuit-breaker-aligned thresholds for single, head-of-household and married filers.
budget_items.quote: $72,000 for single filers, $91,000 for head-of-household filers, and $109,000 for married filers, effective fiscal year 2026

budget_items.topic: Neighborhood code review position (Article Q as discussed)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A temporary in-house position would use at least the previously appropriated amount for the neighborhood code review.
budget_items.quote: utilizing at minimum the $27,500 previously appropriated for that purpose

budget_items.topic: Free cash certification and FY25 closeout
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Free cash certification is unlikely before the Special Town Meeting, and no free cash appropriations are planned for it.
budget_items.quote: certification of free cash is very unlikely to occur prior to the special town meeting, though no appropriations from free cash are planned for that meeting

budget_items.quote: governor healey has announced the withdrawal of $125 million in local earmarks from the fy26 state budget due to revenue shortfalls.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town has two state earmarks totaling $70,000 for school guidance, mental health, special education and school security; not yet confirmed whether affected.
budget_items.quote: the town has two earmarks totaling $70,000 for school guidance, mental health, and special education enhancements, and school security system upgrades.
